name: Trolls

variantInfo.name: River troll
notes: Combat levels are 14-159 and scale with the player's combat level.
Slayer XP is 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, or 4 on the monster page; the task table lists 3-5.
River trolls spawn when fishing in the Enchanted Valley.
It is highly recommended not to slay Enchanted Valley river trolls because they provide severely reduced experience for both combat and Slayer.

variantInfo.name: Thrower Troll
notes: Death Plateau thrower trolls use Ranged and Crush and their ranged attacks are always successful.
The task page notes a possible Death Plateau cannon placement for thrower trolls.
Protect from Missiles is highly recommended while running through the Death Plateau canyon.

variantInfo.name: Thrower troll (Trollheim)
notes: Trollheim thrower trolls only drop bones, including long bones and curved bones.
They attack with Ranged and are aggressive.

variantInfo.name: Mountain troll
notes: Combat levels are 69, 71.
Mountain trolls have Fire and Earth elemental weaknesses depending on version; the level 69 page lists 50% Fire and the level 71 page lists 50% Earth.
They are slightly resistant to crush attacks but equally weak to stab and slash.
They can be completely negated through Protect from Melee.
Mount Quidamortem has two groups of seven mountain trolls and can be reached with Xeric's Honour, the Lovakengj minecart network, or nearby fairy ring routes.

variantInfo.name: Troll spectator
notes: Troll spectators are task-counting Troll arena trolls.
They are non-aggressive and have the same broad stat family as level 71 mountain trolls.

variantInfo.name: Twig
notes: Twig guards the prison in Troll Stronghold and holds cell key 1.
Twig has awake and sleeping versions; both are level 71 trolls.

variantInfo.name: Berry
notes: Berry guards the prison in Troll Stronghold and can provide cell key 2.
Berry may be fought or pickpocketed during Troll Stronghold.

variantInfo.name: Ice troll runt
notes: Ice troll runts are the weakest isle trolls.
On the first island north of Neitiznot, nearby guards help speed up kills and keep many trolls distracted.
If guards deal the finishing blow, Slayer experience is halved but drops are still received if the player dealt damage.
Fire spells are recommended because ice trolls have strong fire weakness.

variantInfo.name: Ice troll male
notes: Ice troll males use melee attacks.
They are common in the recommended northern Jatizso and Neitiznot area.

variantInfo.name: Ice troll female
notes: Ice troll females use powerful Ranged attacks.
A Neitiznot shield reduces the damage from their thrown rocks and is required by the task strategy when killing island ice trolls.
Their ranged accuracy is high, so prayer and shield handling matter.

variantInfo.name: Pee Hat
notes: Pee Hat is a named Death Plateau troll hunted by some Ironman accounts for rune warhammer or granite shield drops.
Protect from Melee blocks the direct melee damage.

variantInfo.name: Kraka
notes: Kraka is a named Death Plateau troll hunted by some Ironman accounts for rune warhammer or granite shield drops.
Kraka is one of the big bad trolls on Death Plateau.

variantInfo.name: Dad
notes: Combat level is 101 (201) with the hard value used in Nightmare Zone.
Dad is a Troll Stronghold quest boss and can be fought in Nightmare Zone after the quest.
Protect from Melee blocks his damage.

variantInfo.name: Ice troll grunt
notes: The task page table lists Ice troll grunt as 102 combat, while the current monster infobox lists 100.
The Neitiznot shield reduces the max hit from rocks thrown by trolls.

variantInfo.name: Stick
notes: Stick can be safespotted with Ranged south-west of his spawn location.
Protect from Melee can completely block his melee damage.
Stick can drop a rune warhammer or granite shield.

variantInfo.name: Rock
notes: Rock is the biggest and baddest Death Plateau troll.
Rock attacks faster than Stick and hits harder.

variantInfo.name: Troll general
notes: Troll generals are scarce, far from the recommended task areas, and have near-nonexistent drops.
They use slash or crush depending on weapon version.

variantInfo.name: Arrg
notes: Combat level is 113 (210) with the hard value used in Nightmare Zone.
Arrg is the Troll Romance quest boss.
Arrg uses slash and ranged attacks.

variantInfo.name: Ice troll
notes: Combat levels are 120, 121, 123, 124.
Slayer XP values are 129, 97, 86, and 86.
Take caution because Ice Path and Trollweiss ice trolls can cause stat drain.
The task page advises against killing Ice Path trolls because they are stronger than isle trolls and have poor drops.

variantInfo.name: Ice Troll King
notes: Combat level is 122 (213) with the hard value used in Nightmare Zone.
The Ice Troll King uses all three attack styles.
His Magic and Ranged defences are extremely high, so melee is the practical method.

variantInfo.name: Reanimated troll
notes: Combat level is N/A on the monster page.
Reanimated trolls are spawned with Adept Reanimation on an ensouled troll head.
They grant 780 Prayer XP and reduced Slayer XP.
The monster page assigns them to the Trolls category.

locationComparison.name: Enchanted Valley
notes: Summon a River troll above your combat level if you start fishing.
The area is reached by fairy ring BKQ.
The task page strongly discourages this option because experience is severely reduced.

locationComparison.name: Northern Jatizso and Neitiznot
notes: Contains 15 female, 14 male, 4 grunt, and 19 runt ice trolls.
Better drops than mountain trolls.
Ice troll females use ranged attacks.
A Neitiznot shield and prayer are required to reduce damage from ice troll females.
The bank on Jatizso is slightly closer to the troll area than Neitiznot.

locationComparison.name: Keldagrim entrance tunnel
notes: Narrow passage makes cannon placement difficult.
Rocks at the sides of the passage can be used to safespot.
Location only contains level 69 melee trolls.

locationComparison.name: South of Mount Quidamortem north-east
notes: More open than the south-west Mount Quidamortem troll location, so luring multiple trolls is easier.
Rocks can be used to safespot.
Closer to a bank than most mountain trolls.

locationComparison.name: South of Mount Quidamortem south-west
notes: High number of obstacles makes safespotting easier.

locationComparison.name: Death Plateau
notes: Protect from Missiles is highly recommended while running through the canyon leading up to the plateau.
Teleporting to Burthorpe with a games necklace or combat bracelet is one of the faster routes.
Shooting through the troll buildings made of rocks makes safespotting easier.
Thrower trolls in the approach can be dangerous because their ranged attacks always hit.

locationComparison.name: Troll Stronghold outside
notes: A dwarf multicannon and a Bonecrusher necklace allow effectively zero Prayer potion usage while using Protect from Melee.
Contains mountain trolls outside the Troll Stronghold.

taskNotes: Trolls can be assigned at 60 combat by Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal.
Trolls are mostly found in the Fremennik Province and north of Burthorpe.
Trolls fought in quests all count towards the Slayer task, with the exception of sea trolls.
Troll bosses can be fought again in the Nightmare Zone.
Players who have completed the Hard Morytania Diary may bring a bonecrusher for passive Prayer experience from big bones.
Players with 92 Magic and the Arceuus spellbook may use Sinister Offering instead.
There are two main practical types of trolls for the task: mountain trolls and ice trolls.
Thrower trolls and troll generals are scarce, far, and have nonexistent or poor drops.
Ice Path trolls are not worth killing because they are stronger than other trolls and have very poor drops for their level.
The task page advises killing island ice trolls instead because they are weaker, have a slightly better drop table, and appear in large quantities in an open multicombat area.
When killing island ice trolls, prayer and a Neitiznot shield are required to reduce damage from ice troll females.
Northern Jatizso is often preferable because guards frequently tank the trolls, reducing player damage taken.
Regardless of which troll is killed, a dwarf multicannon is highly recommended because trolls have low aggression range.
Ice troll runts north of Neitiznot are a quick non-cannon option because nearby guards deal considerable damage and distract the trolls.
If guards deal the finishing blow, Slayer experience is halved, but drops are received as long as the player dealt damage.
Fire spells are recommended against ice trolls because they have strong fire weakness.
recommendedMethod: Use a dwarf multicannon. For profit and speed, kill island ice trolls north of Jatizso/Neitiznot with melee, prayer, and a Neitiznot shield; for lower-risk accessibility, cannon mountain trolls with Protect from Melee. Fire magic is strong against ice trolls and can also quickly finish mountain trolls, but costs more.
